rows.en: Quick start guide to the MHPSS Minimum Service Package for FOOD SECURITY & LIVELIHOODS (FSL) ACTORS
rows.ne: खाद्य सुरक्षा तथा जीविकोपार्जन (FSL) क्षेत्रका सरोकारवालाहरूका लागि मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोग (MHPSS) न्यूनतम सेवा प्याकेज प्रयोग गर्न सुरु गर्ने संक्षिप्त मार्गदर्शिका
rows.bt: A brief guide to starting to use the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) Minimum Service Package for stakeholders in the Food Security and Livelihoods (FSL) sector
rows.note: The MHPSS expansion reuses the cited unreviewed candidate T001.

rows.section: Quick start guide to the MHPSS Minimum Service Package for FOOD SECURITY & LIVELIHOODS (FSL) ACTORS
rows.en: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.ne: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोग न्यूनतम सेवा प्याकेज (MSP) के हो?
rows.bt: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.note: The clinical composite reuses the cited unreviewed candidate T001.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: The MSP outlines priority activities to meet the mental health and psychosocial support needs of emergency-affected populations.
rows.ne: MSP ले आपत्कालबाट प्रभावित जनसमूहको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोगसम्बन्धी आवश्यकता पूरा गर्न प्राथमिकताका गतिविधिहरूको रूपरेखा प्रस्तुत गर्दछ।
rows.bt: The MSP outlines priority activities to meet the mental health and psychosocial support needs of populations affected by emergencies.
rows.note: The clinical composite reuses the cited unreviewed candidate T001.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: It is based on existing guidelines, the best available evidence, and expert consensus.
rows.ne: यो विद्यमान निर्देशिकाहरू, उपलब्ध सर्वोत्तम प्रमाण र विज्ञहरूको सहमतिमा आधारित छ।
rows.bt: It is based on existing guidelines, the best available evidence and expert consensus.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: The goal of the MSP is to contribute to reduced suffering and improved mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.ne: MSP को लक्ष्य पीडा कम गर्न र मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याणमा सुधार ल्याउन योगदान गर्नु हो।
rows.bt: The aim of the MSP is to contribute to reducing suffering and improving mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.note: The combined mental-health and psychosocial-well-being wording is reused from the cited unreviewed candidate T100; T005 is also used literally.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: For more information on what the MSP is, why it is needed and how it can be used, please refer to the MSP guide.
rows.ne: MSP के हो, यो किन आवश्यक छ र यसलाई कसरी प्रयोग गर्न सकिन्छ भन्नेबारे थप जानकारीका लागि MSP मार्गदर्शिका हेर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: For more information about what the MSP is, why it is needed and how it can be used, see the MSP guide.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: How is it relevant to Food Security & Livelihoods (FSL) actors?
rows.ne: यो खाद्य सुरक्षा तथा जीविकोपार्जन (FSL) क्षेत्रका सरोकारवालाहरूका लागि कसरी सान्दर्भिक छ?
rows.bt: How is this relevant to stakeholders in the Food Security and Livelihoods (FSL) sector?

rows.section: How is it relevant to Food Security & Livelihoods (FSL) actors?
rows.en: Emergencies often disrupt access to food and cash, with many people losing their livelihoods and means of survival.
rows.ne: आपत्कालले प्रायः खाद्यान्न र नगदमा पहुँच अवरुद्ध पार्छ, र धेरै मानिसले आफ्नो जीविकोपार्जन र जीवन धान्ने साधन गुमाउँछन्।
rows.bt: Emergencies often obstruct access to food and cash, and many people lose their livelihoods and means of sustaining life.
rows.note: The Nepali explicitly makes loss of livelihoods and means of survival a consequence of disrupted food and cash access. The source presents these together without specifying that causal chain; the revision removes the added causal link.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Food Security & Livelihoods (FSL) actors?
rows.en: This can cause severe stress and force people to engage in risky coping strategies, which may further impact their health, well-being, safety, and social relationships.
rows.ne: यसले गम्भीर तनाव उत्पन्न गर्न र मानिसहरूलाई जोखिमपूर्ण कठिनाइको सामना गर्ने रणनीतिहरू अपनाउन बाध्य पार्न सक्छ, जसले उनीहरूको स्वास्थ्य, कल्याण, सुरक्षा र सामाजिक सम्बन्धहरूमा थप असर पार्न सक्छ।
rows.bt: This can create severe stress and force people to adopt risky strategies for facing difficulties, which can further affect their health, well-being, safety and social relationships.
rows.note: Retains the possibility of severe stress, compulsion to adopt risky coping strategies, and further effects on all four stated areas.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Food Security & Livelihoods (FSL) actors?
rows.en: For example, people may engage in risky migration or trafficking, sex work, child labour, or child marriage.
rows.ne: उदाहरणका लागि, मानिसहरू जोखिमपूर्ण बसाइँसराइ वा मानव बेचबिखन, यौन कार्य, बालश्रम वा बालविवाहमा संलग्न हुन सक्छन्।
rows.bt: For example, people may become involved in risky migration or human trafficking, sex work, child labour or child marriage.
rows.note: The source phrase 'engage in ... trafficking' does not distinguish perpetrating or facilitating trafficking from being subjected to it; the draft retains this ambiguity rather than selecting an interpretation.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Food Security & Livelihoods (FSL) actors?
rows.en: Harmful practices such as these can be extremely detrimental to mental health and psychosocial well-being and may have long-term effects on individual and community-wide recovery.
rows.ne: यस्ता हानिकारक अभ्यासहरू मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याणका लागि अत्यन्त हानिकारक हुन सक्छन् र व्यक्ति तथा समग्र समुदायको पुनःस्थापनामा दीर्घकालीन असर पार्न सक्छन्।
rows.bt: Such harmful practices can be extremely harmful to mental health and psychosocial well-being and can have long-term effects on the recovery of individuals and the community as a whole.
rows.note: Safety draft; review pending. The combined mental-health and psychosocial-well-being wording reuses the cited unreviewed candidate T100.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Food Security & Livelihoods (FSL) actors?
rows.en: Where food insecurity leads to malnutrition, children are at severe risk of disrupted cognitive, emotional, and social development.
rows.ne: खाद्य असुरक्षाका कारण कुपोषण हुने अवस्थामा, बालबालिकाको संज्ञानात्मक, भावनात्मक र सामाजिक विकासमा अवरोध उत्पन्न हुने गम्भीर जोखिम हुन्छ।
rows.bt: In situations where food insecurity causes malnutrition, there is a serious risk of disruption to children's cognitive, emotional and social development.
rows.note: Retains the condition that food insecurity causes malnutrition and the severe risk of disruption across all three developmental domains.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Food Security & Livelihoods (FSL) actors?
rows.en: As community members recover from a humanitarian crisis, FSL programming can help restore their independence, sense of social identity, and meaningful participation in community life.
rows.ne: समुदायका सदस्यहरू मानवीय सङ्कटबाट उकासिँदै जाँदा, FSL कार्यक्रम सञ्चालनले उनीहरूको स्वावलम्बन, सामाजिक पहिचानको अनुभूति र सामुदायिक जीवनमा अर्थपूर्ण सहभागिता पुनःस्थापित गर्न मद्दत गर्न सक्छ।
rows.bt: As community members emerge from a humanitarian crisis, the implementation of FSL programmes can help restore their self-reliance, sense of social identity and meaningful participation in community life.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Food Security & Livelihoods (FSL) actors?
rows.en: Engaging in safe, dignified FSL activities can promote a sense of resilience, agency, and self-efficacy - factors that can be central to mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.ne: सुरक्षित तथा मर्यादित FSL गतिविधिहरूमा सहभागी हुँदा उत्थानशीलता, आफ्नै निर्णयअनुसार काम गर्न सक्ने क्षमता र आफ्नो कार्यक्षमताप्रतिको विश्वासको अनुभूति बढ्न सक्छ—यी तत्त्वहरू मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक कल्याणका लागि केन्द्रीय महत्त्वका हुन सक्छन्।
rows.bt: Participating in safe and dignified FSL activities can increase resilience, the ability to act according to one's own decisions and a feeling of confidence in one's ability to function—these elements can be of central importance for mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.note: Agency and self-efficacy are drafted as distinct general psychological concepts, while both statements retain possibility rather than certainty.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Food Security & Livelihoods (FSL) actors?
rows.en: MHPSS activities can help people to build skills in positive coping, communication, conflict resolution, and many other areas that facilitate effective participation in livelihoods.
rows.ne: MHPSS गतिविधिहरूले मानिसहरूलाई कठिनाइको सकारात्मक रूपमा सामना गर्ने, सञ्चार गर्ने, द्वन्द्व समाधान गर्ने तथा जीविकोपार्जनमा प्रभावकारी सहभागिता सहज बनाउने अन्य धेरै क्षेत्रमा सीप विकास गर्न मद्दत गर्न सक्छन्।
rows.bt: MHPSS activities can help people develop skills in coping positively with difficulties, communicating, resolving conflict and many other areas that facilitate effective participation in livelihoods.
rows.note: Coping is rendered as an ordinary practical skill, not as a named clinical intervention.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Food Security & Livelihoods (FSL) actors?
rows.en: The MSP outlines priority activities FSL actors can contribute to for promoting the mental health and psychosocial well-being of people accessing FSL services.
rows.ne: MSP ले FSL सेवा लिइरहेका मानिसहरूको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न FSL क्षेत्रका सरोकारवालाहरूले योगदान गर्न सक्ने प्राथमिकताका गतिविधिहरूको रूपरेखा प्रस्तुत गर्दछ।
rows.bt: The MSP outlines priority activities to which FSL sector stakeholders can contribute to promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of people receiving FSL services.
rows.note: The combined mental-health and psychosocial-well-being wording reuses the cited unreviewed candidate T100.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Food Security & Livelihoods (FSL) actors?
rows.en: How do I find FSL content in the MSP?
rows.ne: MSP मा FSL सम्बन्धी सामग्री कसरी फेला पार्ने?
rows.bt: How to find FSL-related material in the MSP?

rows.section: How do I find FSL content in the MSP?
rows.en: Each MSP activity is labelled with icons showing which sectors, clusters, or areas of responsibility (AoRs) are typically well placed to deliver it (colourful icons) or contribute to it (dark blue icons).1
rows.ne: प्रत्येक MSP गतिविधिमा कुन क्षेत्र, क्लस्टर वा जिम्मेवारीका क्षेत्रहरू (AoRs) सामान्यतया उक्त गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा छन् भन्ने देखाउने रङ्गीन चित्रचिह्नहरू र त्यसमा योगदान गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा छन् भन्ने देखाउने गाढा निला चित्रचिह्नहरू राखिएका छन्।1
rows.bt: Each MSP activity contains coloured icons showing which sectors, clusters or areas of responsibility (AoRs) are generally well placed to carry out that activity, and dark blue icons showing which are well placed to contribute to it.1
rows.note: The recurring term areas of responsibility (AoRs) is absent from G-0.1. Proposed wording is listed separately; footnote marker 1 is retained.

rows.section: How do I find FSL content in the MSP?
rows.en: The dark-blue FSL icon indicates that FSL actors are typically well-placed to contribute to the implementation of an activity.
rows.ne: गाढा निलो FSL चित्रचिह्नले FSL क्षेत्रका सरोकारवालाहरू सामान्यतया कुनै गतिविधिको कार्यान्वयनमा योगदान गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा छन् भन्ने जनाउँछ।
rows.bt: The dark blue FSL icon indicates that FSL sector stakeholders are generally well placed to contribute to the implementation of an activity.

rows.section: How do I find FSL content in the MSP?
rows.en: For more information, see Who should implement MSP activities?
rows.ne: थप जानकारीका लागि ‘MSP गतिविधिहरू कसले कार्यान्वयन गर्नुपर्छ?’ हेर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: For more information, see ‘Who should implement MSP activities?’

rows.section: How do I find FSL content in the MSP?
rows.en: Figure 1 shows activity 3.3, Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being, as an example.
rows.ne: चित्र 1 मा उदाहरणका रूपमा गतिविधि 3.3, ‘मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न मुख्य सन्देशहरू प्रसार गर्ने’, देखाइएको छ।
rows.bt: Figure 1 shows activity 3.3, ‘Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being’, as an example.
rows.note: The activity label reuses the cited unreviewed candidate T100 verbatim.

rows.section: How do I find FSL content in the MSP?
rows.en: The colourful icons show that Health, Education, Protection, Child Protection, Gender-Based Violence (GBV), Mine Action, Nutrition, and Camp Coordination and Camp Management (CCCM) actors are typically well placed to deliver this activity.
rows.ne: रङ्गीन चित्रचिह्नहरूले स्वास्थ्य, शिक्षा, संरक्षण, बाल संरक्षण, लैङ्गिक हिंसा (GBV), बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्य, पोषण र शिविर समन्वय तथा शिविर व्यवस्थापन (CCCM) क्षेत्रका सरोकारवालाहरू सामान्यतया यो गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा छन् भन्ने देखाउँछन्।
rows.bt: The coloured icons show that stakeholders in the health, education, protection, child protection, gender-based violence (GBV), mine action, nutrition and camp coordination and camp management (CCCM) sectors are generally well placed to carry out this activity.
rows.note: Reclassified as general: this describes sector roles and is not a safeguarding declaration or safety instruction.

rows.section: How do I find FSL content in the MSP?
rows.en: For example, by identifying, refining, and disseminating key MHPSS messages.
rows.ne: उदाहरणका लागि, MHPSS सम्बन्धी मुख्य सन्देशहरू पहिचान, परिष्कार र प्रसार गरेर।
rows.bt: For example, by identifying, refining and disseminating key messages related to MHPSS.
rows.note: The source is an illustrative fragment; that relationship is retained.

rows.section: How do I find FSL content in the MSP?
rows.en: The dark blue icons show that Shelter and Settlements, WASH, and Food Security and Livelihoods actors are typically well placed to contribute to this activity, for example, by helping to disseminate the key messages developed.
rows.ne: गाढा निला चित्रचिह्नहरूले आश्रय तथा बस्ती, WASH र खाद्य सुरक्षा तथा जीविकोपार्जन क्षेत्रका सरोकारवालाहरू सामान्यतया यो गतिविधिमा योगदान गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा छन् भन्ने देखाउँछन्; उदाहरणका लागि, तयार गरिएका मुख्य सन्देशहरू प्रसार गर्न मद्दत गरेर।
rows.bt: The dark blue pictograms show that stakeholders in the shelter and settlements, WASH, and food security and livelihoods sectors are generally in a suitable position to contribute to this activity; for example, by helping to disseminate the prepared key messages.
rows.note: WASH is absent from G-0.1. Its proposed Nepali expansion is provisional and does not amend the glossary. The added Nepali WASH expansion specifies drinking water, a restriction absent from the source acronym and obscured by the BT's broader 'water'. The revision retains WASH exactly without supplying an unreviewed expansion.

rows.section: How do I find FSL content in the MSP?
rows.en: Figure 1 Health, Education, Protection, Child Protection, GBV, Mine Action, Nutrition, CCCM: typically well placed to deliver the activity
rows.ne: चित्र 1 स्वास्थ्य, शिक्षा, संरक्षण, बाल संरक्षण, GBV, बारुदी सुरुङ सम्बन्धी कार्य, पोषण, CCCM: सामान्यतया गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा रहेका क्षेत्रहरू
rows.bt: Figure 1 Health, education, protection, child protection, GBV, mine action, nutrition, CCCM: sectors generally well placed to carry out the activity

rows.section: How do I find FSL content in the MSP?
rows.en: 3.3 Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being
rows.ne: 3.3 मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न मुख्य सन्देशहरू प्रसार गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.3 Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.note: The activity label reuses the cited unreviewed candidate T100 verbatim, with a final danda.

rows.section: How do I find FSL content in the MSP?
rows.en: Shelter & Settlements, WASH, Food Security & Livelihoods: typically well placed to contribute to the activity
rows.ne: आश्रय तथा बस्ती, WASH, खाद्य सुरक्षा तथा जीविकोपार्जन: सामान्यतया गतिविधिमा योगदान गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा रहेका क्षेत्रहरू
rows.bt: Shelter and settlements, WASH, food security and livelihoods: sectors generally well placed to contribute to the activity
rows.note: WASH is retained as supplied. The recurring term is absent from G-0.1; a provisional expansion is proposed separately.

rows.en: 1 The icons are not intended to be prescriptive, but a guide to who typically does what.
rows.ne: 1 चित्रचिह्नहरूको उद्देश्य कसले के गर्नैपर्छ भनेर तोक्नु होइन, सामान्यतया कसले के गर्छ भन्नेबारे मार्गदर्शन दिनु हो।
rows.bt: 1 The purpose of the icons is not to specify who must do what, but to provide guidance on who generally does what.

rows.en: Which MSP activities are most relevant to FSL actors?
rows.ne: कुन MSP गतिविधिहरू FSL क्षेत्रका सरोकारवालाहरूका लागि सबैभन्दा सान्दर्भिक छन्?
rows.bt: Which MSP activities are most relevant to FSL sector stakeholders?

rows.section: Which MSP activities are most relevant to FSL actors?
rows.en: MSP activities are organized into four sections.
rows.ne: MSP गतिविधिहरू चार खण्डमा व्यवस्थित गरिएका छन्।
rows.bt: MSP activities are organized into four sections.

rows.section: Which MSP activities are most relevant to FSL actors?
rows.en: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.ne: खण्ड 1: अन्तरनिकाय समन्वय र लेखाजोखा
rows.bt: Section 1: Inter-agency coordination and assessment
rows.note: Reclassified as general: this is a section heading, not an activity label.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: Activities 1.1 and 1.2 are particularly relevant for coordination groups in all sectors and AoRs, and cross-cutting MHPSS technical working groups.
rows.ne: गतिविधि 1.1 र 1.2 सबै क्षेत्र र जिम्मेवारीका क्षेत्रहरू (AoRs) का समन्वय समूहहरू तथा विभिन्न क्षेत्रलाई समेट्ने MHPSS प्राविधिक कार्यसमूहहरू (technical working groups) का लागि विशेष रूपमा सान्दर्भिक छन्।
rows.bt: Activities 1.1 and 1.2 are particularly relevant to coordination groups for all sectors and areas of responsibility (AoRs), and to MHPSS technical working groups that cover different sectors.
rows.note: The recurring term areas of responsibility (AoRs) is absent from G-0.1. The proposed rendering is provisional; the English working-group label is included at first occurrence as requested by T050.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: They promote effective inter-agency and intersectoral coordination and assessment.

rows.en: Whenever possible, including MHPSS-related factors in FSL needs assessments: e.g. assessing social and cultural factors related to food security, nutrition, and food aid, such as dietary beliefs and practices, household roles, and cultural taboos. Assessing food security for persons in mental hospitals and institutions.
rows.ne: सम्भव भएसम्म FSL सम्बन्धी आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखा गर्दा MHPSS सम्बन्धी पक्षहरू समावेश गर्ने: उदाहरणका लागि खाद्य सुरक्षा, पोषण र खाद्य सहायतासँग सम्बन्धित सामाजिक तथा सांस्कृतिक पक्षहरूको लेखाजोखा गर्ने, जसमा खानपानसम्बन्धी विश्वास र अभ्यास, घरपरिवारभित्रका भूमिका तथा सांस्कृतिक वर्जनाहरू पर्छन्। मानसिक अस्पताल र संस्थाहरूमा रहेका व्यक्तिहरूको खाद्य सुरक्षाको लेखाजोखा गर्ने।
rows.bt: Where possible, include MHPSS-related aspects when assessing FSL-related needs: for example, assess social and cultural aspects related to food security, nutrition and food assistance, including beliefs and practices related to eating, roles within households and cultural taboos. Assess the food security of people in mental hospitals and institutions.
rows.note: Proposed missing terms: food security = खाद्य सुरक्षा; food aid = खाद्य सहायता. The institutional term reuses the cited unreviewed candidate T015; this is not clinical validation.

rows.en: Section 2 activities (on programme design, implementing an M&E system, caring for staff and volunteers and supporting MHPSS competencies) should be implemented by all organizations delivering MHPSS activities.

rows.bt: It is advisable for all organizations conducting MHPSS activities to implement the activities in Section 2; these activities relate to programme design, implementation of the monitoring and evaluation (M&E) system, care for staff and volunteers, and support for MHPSS competencies.

rows.section: Sections 3 & 4: MHPSS Programme Activities
rows.en: The programmatic activities that Food Security & Livelihoods actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.ne: खाद्य सुरक्षा तथा जीविकोपार्जन क्षेत्रका कर्ताहरू सामान्यतया योगदान दिन उपयुक्त स्थितिमा रहने कार्यक्रमगत गतिविधिहरू निम्न छन्:
rows.bt: The following are programme activities that actors in the food security and livelihoods sector are generally well placed to contribute to:
rows.note: Uses the proposed missing sector label Food Security & Livelihoods = खाद्य सुरक्षा तथा जीविकोपार्जन.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Food Security & Livelihoods actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: 3.1 Orient humanitarian actors and community members on MHPSS and advocate for MHPSS considerations and actions
rows.ne: 3.1 मानवीय कर्ता र समुदायका सदस्यलाई MHPSS बारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने र MHPSS सम्बन्धी विचारणीय पक्ष तथा कार्यका लागि पैरवी गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.1 Orient humanitarian actors and community members on MHPSS and advocate for MHPSS-related considerations and actions.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Food Security & Livelihoods actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: Collaborating with MHPSS experts to orient FSL actors on MHPSS and interlinkages between MHPSS and FSL. Providing assistance in ways that support mental health and psychosocial well-being: • Promoting the participation of target communities in FSL programming and long-term food-security planning, including groups at heightened risk such as women, persons with disabilities, persons with mental health conditions, and older adults. • Delivering food aid in a culturally appropriate manner that protects the identity, integrity, and dignity of communities (e.g. considering religious and cultural practices related to food items and food preparation and ensuring that food aid reaches all intended recipients without discrimination). • Ensuring livelihood options are context-appropriate and promote community cohesion. • Taking steps to ensure that livelihood programmes do not privilege certain groups or increase the risk of conflict (e.g. engaging community members from different groups in the mapping of risks and identification of risk mitigation and protection strategies). • Facilitating access to livelihood opportunities for people with mental health conditions and psychosocial disabilities and their families.
rows.ne:
FSL सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूलाई MHPSS र MHPSS तथा FSL बीचका अन्तरसम्बन्धहरूबारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्न MHPSS विशेषज्ञहरूसँग सहकार्य गर्ने। मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक कल्याणमा टेवा पुग्ने तरिकाले सहायता प्रदान गर्ने:
• महिला, अपाङ्गता भएका व्यक्तिहरू, मानसिक स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी अवस्था भएका व्यक्तिहरू / मानसिक स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी अवस्था हुन सक्ने व्यक्तिहरू र ज्येष्ठ वयस्कहरूजस्ता बढी जोखिममा रहेका समूहहरूलाई समेत समेटेर FSL कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयन र दीर्घकालीन खाद्य सुरक्षाको योजनामा लक्षित समुदायहरूको सहभागिता प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने।
• समुदायहरूको पहिचान, अखण्डता र मर्यादाको संरक्षण गर्ने गरी सांस्कृतिक रूपमा उपयुक्त तरिकाले खाद्य सहायता वितरण गर्ने (उदाहरणका लागि, खाद्यवस्तु र खाना तयार गर्ने प्रक्रियासँग सम्बन्धित धार्मिक तथा सांस्कृतिक अभ्यासहरूलाई ध्यानमा राख्ने र भेदभावबिना सबै लक्षित प्राप्तकर्तासम्म खाद्य सहायता पुग्ने सुनिश्चित गर्ने)।
• जीविकोपार्जनका विकल्पहरू सन्दर्भअनुकूल भएको र तिनले समुदायको एकतालाई प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने सुनिश्चित गर्ने।
• जीविकोपार्जनका कार्यक्रमहरूले कुनै समूहलाई विशेष लाभ नदिने वा द्वन्द्वको जोखिम नबढाउने सुनिश्चित गर्न कदम चाल्ने (उदाहरणका लागि, जोखिमहरूको नक्साङ्कन गर्न र जोखिम न्यूनीकरण तथा संरक्षणका रणनीतिहरू पहिचान गर्न विभिन्न समूहका समुदाय सदस्यहरूलाई सहभागी गराउने)।
• मानसिक स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी अवस्था भएका व्यक्तिहरू / मानसिक स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी अवस्था हुन सक्ने व्यक्तिहरू र मनोसामाजिक अपाङ्गता भएका व्यक्तिहरू तथा उनीहरूका परिवारहरूका लागि जीविकोपार्जनका अवसरहरूमा पहुँच सहज बनाउने।
rows.bt:
Collaborate with MHPSS specialists to orient FSL-related parties on MHPSS and the interrelationships between MHPSS and FSL. Provide assistance in ways that support mental health and psychosocial well-being:
• Promote the participation of targeted communities in the design and implementation of FSL programmes and in planning for long-term food security, including groups at greater risk such as women, persons with disabilities, persons with mental health conditions / persons who may have mental health conditions and older adults.
• Distribute food assistance in culturally appropriate ways that protect communities' identity, integrity and dignity (for example, take into account religious and cultural practices related to food items and the food preparation process, and ensure that food assistance reaches all targeted recipients without discrimination).
• Ensure that livelihood options are appropriate to the context and that they promote community unity.
• Take steps to ensure that livelihood programmes do not give special benefits to any group or increase the risk of conflict (for example, involve community members from different groups to map risks and identify risk reduction and protection strategies).
• Facilitate access to livelihood opportunities for persons with mental health conditions / persons who may have mental health conditions and persons with psychosocial disabilities, and their families.
rows.note: The frozen population label includes an alternative for persons with possible mental health conditions, whereas both source mentions specify persons with mental health conditions without that possibility qualifier; the full frozen label is retained unchanged at both occurrences as required. bt-divergence: At both population mentions, the frozen T486 form adds persons who may have mental health conditions alongside persons with mental health conditions. The source specifies persons with mental health conditions only, without a possibility qualifier. This broadens the population scope. The frozen form is retained unchanged; no repair is made because removing the added alternative would revise that form.

rows.bt: Orient FSL workers on basic psychosocial support, including identifying children and adults who may need MHPSS and referring them to the relevant services.
rows.note: The phrase for basic psychosocial support is reused verbatim from the cited unreviewed T099 candidate; the complete T099 label is not used. rows.ne: 3.3 मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न मुख्य सन्देशहरू प्रसार गर्ने।

rows.bt: Where possible, include key messages related to MHPSS in FSL activities and informational materials.

rows.en: 3.4 Support new and pre-existing group-based community MHPSS activities
rows.ne: 3.4 नयाँ तथा पहिलेदेखि सञ्चालित समूहमा आधारित सामुदायिक MHPSS गतिविधिलाई सहयोग गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.4 Support new and already operating group-based community MHPSS activities.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Food Security & Livelihoods actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: Supporting group-based community MHPSS activities. For example, by facilitating combined livelihoods and MHPSS programming through peer-support groups (e.g., youth groups, women groups) or structured group sessions (e.g. on coping and problem-solving skills) for livelihood programme participants.
rows.ne: समूहमा आधारित सामुदायिक MHPSS गतिविधिहरूलाई सहयोग गर्ने। उदाहरणका लागि, जीविकोपार्जन कार्यक्रमका सहभागीहरूका लागि समकक्षी सहयोग समूहहरू (जस्तै, युवा समूह र महिला समूह) वा संरचित सामूहिक सत्रहरू (जस्तै, कठिनाइको सामना गर्ने र समस्या समाधान गर्ने सीपसम्बन्धी सत्रहरू) मार्फत जीविकोपार्जन र MHPSS लाई संयोजन गरी कार्यक्रम सञ्चालन गर्न सहजीकरण गर्ने।
rows.bt: Support group-based community MHPSS activities. For example, facilitate conducting programmes combining livelihoods and MHPSS through peer support groups (such as youth groups and women's groups) or structured group sessions (such as sessions on skills for coping with difficulties and solving problems) for participants in livelihood programmes.
rows.note: Proposed missing ordinary programme terms: livelihoods = जीविकोपार्जन; peer-support groups = आपसी सहयोग समूहहरू; coping and problem-solving skills = कठिनाइको सामना गर्ने र समस्या समाधान गर्ने सीप. These are drafted as general group-support and practical skills wording, not as a named clinical intervention. 'Mutual support groups' omits the peer relationship specified by 'peer-support groups'; mutual support alone does not establish that participants are peers.

rows.section: How can I get more help?
rows.en: The Step-by-Step Guide for different users provides guidance on how implementing organizations and coordinators can use the MSP.

rows.bt: The Step-by-Step Guide prepared for different users provides guidance on how implementing organizations and coordinators can use the MSP.
rows.note: Step-by-Step Guide is absent from the supplied glossary; a title rendering is proposed without changing the glossary.

rows.section: How can I get more help?
rows.en: You can contact the MSP Helpdesk for tailored support by emailing mhpss.msp@gmail.com and mhpss.refgroup@gmail.com.
rows.ne: आफ्नो आवश्यकताअनुसार सहयोग प्राप्त गर्न तपाईंले mhpss.msp@gmail.com र mhpss.refgroup@gmail.com मा इमेल पठाएर MSP सहायता कक्ष (Helpdesk) लाई सम्पर्क गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ।
rows.bt: To obtain support according to your needs, you can contact the MSP Helpdesk by sending an email to mhpss.msp@gmail.com and mhpss.refgroup@gmail.com.
rows.note: Preserve the URL or email address exactly. Both email addresses are preserved exactly. Helpdesk is a recurring term absent from the supplied glossary; a rendering is proposed.
